news.title: How the EU is positioning itself for Antalya
news.summary: Europe leads with electrification; observers argue that falls short and want concrete steps on phasing out fossil fuels. Paywalled.

news.title: Council sets EU position ahead of COP31 and COP17
news.summary: Ministers accept 1.5°C is likely to be exceeded and back an overshoot-peak-decline pathway. They call for NDC implementation, the transition away from fossil fuels, clean electrification and participation of all member states.

news.title: Ministers ready to promote fossil-fuel transition and electrification
news.summary: Fossil-fuel phase-out language stays in the conclusions. O'Brien says the Presidency wanted short, considered text without ruling other elements out.

news.title: EU to push a 'mitigation package' at COP31
news.summary: An Irish Presidency draft seen by Reuters asks to extend the mitigation work programme to 2040 and for a collective response to the confirmed 1.5°C overshoot.

news.title: O'Brien and O'Sullivan chair Environment Council
news.summary: Ireland, as lead EU negotiator, wrote to Commissioner Hoekstra and EU counterparts on COP31 preparations, stressing a more strategic and assertive approach.

news.title: COP31 champion urges shift from pledges to action
news.summary: High-Level Champion Samed Ağırbaş expects over 100,000 attendees from 193 countries and says success means delivering targets rather than announcing new ones.

news.title: EU tempers hopes for COP31
news.summary: A Commission official warns against arriving with overly high expectations. France keeps pressing for a more transactional line with large emerging economies; Hoekstra rejects that view.

news.title: Council conclusions on climate finance
news.summary: Finance conclusions adopted ahead of COP31, complementing the general EU position.

news.title: Pre-COP closing day wrap
news.summary: About 4,000 people from over 100 nations met in Fiji. Pacific priorities: 1.5°C, the ocean-climate nexus and faster access to finance.

news.title: Hoekstra at Pre-COP: keeping 1.5 within reach
news.summary: Hoekstra calls COP31 a COP of implementation and urges G20 economies to raise both emission cuts and climate finance.

news.title: Hoekstra at the Pre-COP Leaders' Plenary
news.summary: Commits EU support for Pacific early warning and resilient infrastructure, and calls 1.5°C, including a return below it after overshoot, non-negotiable.

news.title: Who holds the gavel? COP31's unusual deal
news.summary: Kurum stresses Türkiye is not co-chairing and the final decision rests with the Presidency; Bowen says the arrangement works.

news.title: 35-by-35 Electrification Pledge and Antalya AI Pledge
news.summary: Two flagship pledges launched at Climate Week NYC. Türkiye targets 35% of final energy use from electricity by 2035.

news.title: Türkiye says it has 'final decision' at COP31
news.summary: Kurum says Australia runs the negotiations under the partnership modalities, but final decisions rest with Türkiye.

news.title: Presidency sets ten priority themes
news.summary: Third letter to Parties: clean energy, zero waste and methane, resilient cities, green industrialisation, food, oceans, health, Rio synergies, youth and a Climate Implementation Bridge.

news.title: Interview: COP31 president on electrification
news.summary: Kurum frames electrification as the surest way to protect citizens.

news.title: EU rallies behind Cyprus over COP31 exclusion
news.summary: Member states and the Commission condemn Türkiye for leaving Cyprus out of preparatory talks. Paywalled.

news.title: EU's 'shorter, sharper' COP31 strategy
news.summary: Irish Presidency paper after COP30: fewer, clearer priorities, early outreach and ministers deployed strategically before and during COP31.

voices.name: Wopke Hoekstra
voices.role: EU Commissioner for Climate, Net Zero and Clean Growth
voices.latest: At Pre-COP named four COP31 priorities: closing the ambition gap, climate finance, a more efficient UNFCCC and science-based decisions.

voices.name: Darragh O'Brien
voices.role: Irish Minister for Climate; head of the EU delegation
voices.latest: "COP31 must be the turning point where commitments become tangible reality."

voices.name: Murat Kurum
voices.latest: Calls closing the climate finance gap a main Antalya priority; insists final decisions rest with the Presidency.

voices.name: Chris Bowen
voices.role: COP31 President of Negotiations; Australian minister
voices.latest: Says Pre-COP gave the talks their launching pad; electrification will be central in Antalya.

voices.name: Simon Stiell
voices.latest: Pledged UN support for Türkiye and Australia to make Antalya deliver for people, prosperity and planet.

voices.name: Samed Ağırbaş
voices.latest: Climate justice and finance top the agenda; success means delivering targets, not new announcements.

voices.name: Lynda Tabuya
voices.role: Fiji Minister for Climate Change; Pre-COP host
voices.latest: Set four Pacific priorities: 1.5°C, finance that reaches communities, ocean at the centre, Pacific leadership.

voices.name: Alden Meyer
voices.latest: On the deal: there has never been a shared COP presidency before.

position.headline: A mitigation package, not a headline target

points.v: Accepts 1.5°C is likely to be exceeded; backs an overshoot-peak-decline pathway to return below 1.5°C by 2100.
Effective implementation of national plans and urgent submission of missing NDCs.
Deliver the first global stocktake: transition away from fossil fuels and an accelerated clean energy transition, with clean electrification central.
Space in the talks for mitigation and a steer for the second global stocktake. Reuters reports the EU wants the mitigation work programme extended to 2040.
Mitigation and adaptation treated as complementary; resilience a prerequisite for prosperity.
Separate Council conclusions on climate finance adopted 9 Oct.
Stresses that all EU member states take part in COP31, a reference to Cyprus's exclusion from preparatory talks.

watch: Whether France's call for a more transactional line with emerging economies shapes EU tactics on the floor.
How the EU uses coalitions outside consensus talks, which Hoekstra has favoured.
Cyprus: Türkiye's handling of a member state the EU insists must participate.
The EU's proposed design for a Just Transition Mechanism, discussed by member states in September.
